story.fullStory:
Eddie Floyd's "Knock On Wood" reached #28 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Knock on Wood" is a song by Eddie Floyd and Steve Cropper released as a single by Floyd in 1966.

The song peaked at #28 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 17 weeks on the chart.

Knock On Wood was released in 1966.
